blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) is one of the leading property developers in the country for over 40 years has been awarded the prestigious 3G Award for Environmental Responsibility for 2024. RLC receives this recognition due to its continuous strong initiatives to reduce its carbon footprint.

“We would like to extend our utmost gratitude to 3G Awards and to Cambridge IFA for this recognition – 3G Excellence Award for Environmental Responsibility 2024. This award will inspire us to ensure our projects will prioritize obtaining environment friendly energy sources to reduce carbon footprint alongside our other ESG initiatives. We shall continue seeking opportunities to lower emissions on the usage of our developments and shall continue to contribute in the fight against climate change in order to create value for our stakeholders and society.” – Kerwin Max S. Tan, Chief Financial, Risk and Compliance Officer, Robinsons Land Corporation.

RLC has continuously positioned itself in various strategic locations all over the Philippines. It offers a wide range of brands to suit the changing needs of the population. To date, RLC has 54 Lifestyle Centers, 90 Residential Buildings, 41 Residential Subdivisions, 26 Hotels and Resorts, 31 Office Developments, 29 Mixed-Use Developments and Destination Estates, 9 Service Offices and 9 Logistics and Industrial Facilities.

The huge portfolio of assets has positioned RLC to be one of the Philippines most diversified property developer. Mr. Tan adds that its diversified portfolio, RLC has been able to create value for its stakeholders by pursuing growth prospects that complement the advancement of society.
While committing itself to establish high-quality developments that create superior value to its market, RLC has always valued the best interest of its stakeholders.
